# Eldoria photographic interior assets

Created with the built-in image generation tool. Photographic-style original fantasy interiors; not photographs of real locations.

Common prompt: Cinematic architectural interior photography of a practical fantasy movie set; realistic wood, stone and fabrics; natural light; wide 24mm eye-level view from the entrance; open foreground for game characters; furnished walls and background; no people, text, watermarks, borders or UI.

- cottage.jpg: Cozy elven woodland cottage living room and kitchen, stone fireplace, carved oak beams, linen curtains, cooking hearth, natural timber furniture.
- royal.jpg: Majestic elven castle throne hall, branching carved stone columns, tall stained glass, royal banners, distant throne, vaulted ceiling, court dining alcoves.
- manor.jpg: Wealthy elven family manor great room, sweeping staircase, carved gallery balcony, ancestral portraits, luxurious sitting areas, floral tapestries.
- tavern.jpg: Bustling-looking but unoccupied medieval elven tavern interior, dining alcoves, laid tables, stocked wooden bar, open cooking kitchen, roaring stone fireplace.
- workshop.jpg: Elven shoemaker workshop, leather patterns on walls, precise hand tools, sewing supplies, boots on shelves, real worn wooden workbenches, storeroom doorway.
- library.jpg: Ancient elven archive library, towering bookshelves, rolling ladders, carved balconies, records and scrolls, reading alcoves, warm tall windows.
- apothecary.jpg: Elven herbal apothecary laboratory, hanging dried herbs, glass ingredient jars, copper brewing kettles, worktable, small greenhouse through rear arch.
- runes.jpg: Ancient elven rune sanctuary, carved stone arches, glowing engraved runestones, crystals, star ceiling, magical study area, atmospheric but clear.
- dormitory.jpg: Historic medieval orphanage dormitory, weathered plaster, individual wooden sleeping alcoves, quilts, narrow windows, small schoolroom beyond doorway, somber but readable.
- stable.jpg: Elven carriage-house interior, massive timber rafters, wagon bays, realistic wooden carriage, harness racks, hay storage, stone floor, broad doors.

- study.jpg: Elven detective study, detailed evidence noticeboard, document cabinets, parchment maps, journals, ink pots, organized investigation desk, stone and carved timber.
- cellar.jpg: Medieval elven bell cellar, weathered stone vaults, old brass bell mechanisms, wooden storage cupboards, lanterns, worn stone floor, investigation worktable.
